name: QR Code
description: A hideable bar of QR code buttons, docked on any frame edge and dragged from edge to edge like a navbar. Expanded it shows an icon per QR code; collapsed just the arrow that brings it back. Each QR encodes a URL, text or Wi-Fi credentials and also opens through an action bindable to gestures.
author: shin-01

settings.title: Show bar
settings.description: Turn the QR code bar on or off.

settings.title: Docking
settings.description: Edge snaps the bar to a frame edge, like a navbar. Free leaves it wherever you drop it.

settings.title: Frame edge
settings.description: The frame edge the bar hugs. Dragging redocks it on the edge nearest the release.

settings.title: Position along the edge
settings.description: Kept by the bar when you drag it: its center along the edge, relative to the kiosk's center.

settings.title: Free position X
settings.description: Kept by the bar when you drag it: horizontal center, relative to the kiosk's center.

settings.title: Free position Y
settings.description: Kept by the bar when you drag it: vertical center, relative to the kiosk's center.

settings.title: QR size
settings.description: The size of the QR code in the full screen card.

settings.title: Title
settings.description: The heading of this QR's card.

settings.title: Bar icon
settings.description: The icon this QR code shows on the bar.

settings.title: Content type
settings.description: What this QR code encodes.

settings.title: Network name (SSID)
settings.description: The Wi-Fi network the QR code joins.

settings.title: Security
settings.description: The network's security type.

settings.title: Password
settings.description: The Wi-Fi password, masked in the Plugin Manager and Remote Admin.

settings.title: URL
settings.description: The link the QR code opens.

settings.title: Text
settings.description: Any text the QR code carries.
